meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents... “30A Florida Flashback”, a sun-soaked coastal getaway tucked in the heart of Dune Allen Beach. This spacious 5 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom retreat sleeps 12 and is designed for unforgettable family vacations, group gatherings and laid back beach
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... “30A Florida Flashback”, a sun-soaked coastal getaway tucked in the heart of Dune Allen Beach. This spacious 5 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom retreat sleeps 12 and is designed for unforgettable family vacations, group gatherings and laid back beach days. With a private pool, fenced backyard that is perfect for pups, 6-seater LSV and 7 bikes included, getting to the beach or cruising along 30A is a breeze. Enjoy peaceful mornings on the front porch, afternoons splashing in the pool and evenings grilling out beneath the stars. Sitting on an expansive lot with generous parking and outdoor living spaces, this home is the perfect blend of comfort, convenience and classic Florida charm. Learn more below… 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***5 Bedrooms + 3.5 Bathrooms that sleep 12 comfortablyPrivate pool with loungers, firepit seating and outdoor living space6-Seater LSV included for easy beach runs and exploring 30APet friendly home with fenced backyard - perfect for four-legged friendsExpansive fenced backyard perfect for kids, games and relaxationChef’s kitchen with stainless appliances, bar seating for 4 and dining for 8Spacious living area with sectional sofa and flat-screen TVTons of outdoor space with multiple patios, ping pong table and grill7 bikes included to explore Dune Allen, Gulf Place and nearby beach towns*** LIVING AREAS ***Relax and reconnect in the bright open living spaces that make this home ideal for groups. Whether you’re gathering for movies, morning coffee or a fun game night, there’s room for everyone to unwind.Large living room with sectional seating and flat screen-TVSeamless flow from kitchen to dining to outdoor patioFront porch with plenty of seating for slow mornings or evening cocktailsDownstairs patio with ping pong table, flat screen TV-and comfy lounge areas*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Designed for big meals and easy entertaining, the kitchen is fully equipped for everything from pancake breakfasts to shrimp boils after the beach.Chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceBar seating for 4 at the oversized islandDining table for 8 for family style mealsPatio off the kitchen with gas grill and al fresco dining for 6*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Spacious, comfortable and thoughtfully designed, each bedroom offers a restful retreat after sun soaked days along 30A.First FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screenTV, patio access and En-Suite with single vanity and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Two queen beds, flat-screen TV and patio accessPowder Room: Conveniently located off the entrySecond FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, dedicated workspace and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and shared access to guest bathroomShared Guest Bathroom: Single vanity and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat- screen TV and shared access to guest bathroom*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Step outside and enjoy resort style living in your own backyard. With multiple places to lounge, dine and play the outdoor living spaces make this home shine.Private pool with loungers for sunbathingOutdoor living area with seating and flat screen TVGas firepit with seating for 4Fenced backyard ideal for kids,pets, games and gatheringsOutdoor shower perfect for rinsing after the beach7 bikes included for scenic rides along 30A*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Dune Allen Beach is known for its natural beauty, relaxed atmosphere and unbeatable access to the best of 30A. From beach days to dining adventures everything is minutes away.Beach access just a 10 minute walk or 3 minute bike ride awayGulf Place is just minutes away for live music shopping and great diningBlue Mountain Beach for ice cream stops and local charmGrayton Beach for nightlife culture and a world class state parkClose to Topsail State Park for hikes and dune explorationLocal dining favorites nearby like Stinky’s Fish Camp and Shunk Gulley*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogPets are not allowed in the pool at anytimeWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes and LSV. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThere is an active Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the homePlease note that the airstream is NOT for guest use.*** YOUR STAY — OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes we are committed to providing a luxurious safe and stress free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***
